subject: Kickoff: procurement intake & security evidence delivery for NovaMed PO
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@novamed.com, Luke Carter <l.carter@novamed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: procurement intake & security evidence delivery for NovaMed PO

Hi Luke / Novamed procurement team,

Thanks for the opportunity to work with NovaMed. To keep the PO and contracting timeline tight, we want to kick off the procurement intake and collect the minimum security/compliance evidence your procurement and InfoSec teams require. Attached is a short checklist to speed this up.

Primary items we typically need before Legal will finalize terms: 
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest 12-month period) or SOC 2 summary for procurement intake
- ISO 27001 certificate (if applicable)
- External penetration test letter / executive summary (last 12 months)
- Data retention & deletion policy (customer data handling)
- KMS/HSM key management summary and encryption-at-rest details
- Subprocessor list and SCC/DPAs (if EU data involved)

Request: could you confirm the PO number you intend to issue and whether your procurement team requires a W-9 or VAT registration from us? Also confirm a preferred point of contact for security questions (name + email) so we can loop Legal/Security directly.

Attachments: redwood-procurement-kickoff-checklist.pdf (procurement checklist), SOC2-summary-2026.pdf (high-level SOC 2 summary)

Proposed timeline: if we get the documents by EOD Tue (2026-09-07), Legal can move contracts to your review by Thu (2026-09-09). If you need a call to walk the checklist, happy to schedule 30 minutes.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0147

From: Luke Carter <l.carter@novamed.com>

Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: procurement intake & security evidence delivery for NovaMed PO

Hi Alex —

Appreciate the checklist. Quick answers: PO will be generated once Legal has the SOC2 + pen test summary. Our procurement team needs a completed vendor form (I attached our intake template in my reply below). Our security lead for this is me (Luke Carter) — please send any security-specific materials to l.carter@novamed.com.

Clarifications: 
- For the SOC 2, a redacted Type II is fine (we only need the auditor letter + control coverage)
- Pen test: an executive summary plus attestation letter is sufficient for procurement (no full raw reports shared)
- KMS: one-paragraph key management statement + whether you use a cloud KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, HSM) is fine

I'll attach the vendor intake form in my next email (procurement requires the completed form with tax info). Can you confirm Redwood's remit on data residency? We will need to document region controls in the PO.

Thanks — sending procurement form now.

— Luke
Luke Carter
Director, Information Security
NovaMed Health
l.carter@novamed.com
